title: Iowa man pays $9k to use land, cuts trees; court finds no deal, owner keeps cash

The court determined that Robbins's payments were intended for storage, not a property sale. Wilson kept $9,000 for storage and related damages. This decision was confirmed by the Iowa Court of Appeals, highlighting a lack of evidence for a valid agreement between the parties.

title: Taiwan's ruling DPP loses Taipei mayoral race as KMT retains capital and New Taipei

Voters also participated in a referendum regarding the ban on nuclear power and expressed economic concerns.

title: Google builds ‘Mirror Dimension’, synthetic version of internet to test Chrome AI agents
